Name: Lewis' New Truck
Author: ApollyonSV
Description:
[center][size=6][u][b]﻿About This Mod[/b][/u][/size]

[size=3]Lewis decided to buy himself a brand new pickup truck! [/size]

[size=4][b]Current options available as of version 1.0 (See chart at bottom of page for visual)[/b]

[u]Tenth Generation Ford F-150 (1997-2003)[/u] available in 8 colors ( Bright Red, Dark Toreador Red, Moonlight Blue, Teal, Pacific Green, Silver Frost, Oxford White, Black Clearcoat )
[/size]

[size=3]I will most likely be adding more vehicle options in the future when time allows. Would also love to see others pick up on this idea and share their creativity![/size]

[u][size=6][b]Installation[/b]
[/size][/u]
[size=3]- Download and install[/size][b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/url][b]﻿ [/b][size=3]if you don't have it already[/size]
[size=3]- Download[/size][b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]. I highly recommend this as it will make configuring the in game changes a whole lot easier[/size]
[size=3]- Download Lewis' New Truck[/size]
[size=3]- Unpack the contents of the archive to your .../StardewValley/Mods folder using a program such as WinRAR[/size]

[size=3]*If you have the Generic Mod Config Menu downloaded, just click on the lower left cog button on the main menu screen, find Lewis New Truck, and make changes there. Don't forget to save and close![/size]


[size=3]Launch the game and enjoy![/size]
